from pathlib import Path
import json, sqlite3
CID='MANUAL-SCOUT-HENGELTJES-20260924'
root=Path.home()/'prediction_research_prod'/'knowledge'/'codex_runtime'
hits=[]
for p in (root/'candidate_states').glob('*.json'):
    try:x=json.loads(p.read_text())
    except Exception:continue
    if x.get('candidate_id')==CID:hits.append((p.stat().st_mtime,p,x))
if not hits:
    print('0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'); raise SystemExit(0)
_,p,x=max(hits)
db=sqlite3.connect(f"file:{root/'runtime.sqlite'}?mode=ro",uri=True)
rows=db.execute('select id,body,status,attempt from tasks order by rowid').fetchall(); db.close()
ts=[]
for tid,body,status,attempt in rows:
    try:b=json.loads(body)
    except Exception:continue
    if b.get('candidate_id')==CID:ts.append((tid,b,status,attempt))
pl=[t for t in ts if t[1].get('candidate_build_planner')]
bu=[t for t in ts if t[1].get('task_class')=='infrastructure_build']
print('QUEUE_STATUS='+str(x.get('queue_status')))
print('PLANNERS='+str([(t[0],t[2]) for t in pl]))
print('BUILDS='+str([(t[0],t[2]) for t in bu]))
if not pl: code='0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
elif not any(t[2]=='COMPLETE' for t in pl): code='aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa'
elif not bu: code='1111111111111111111111111111111111111111'
elif any(t[2]=='FAILED' for t in bu): code='4444444444444444444444444444444444444444'
elif any(t[2]=='COMPLETE' for t in bu): code='3333333333333333333333333333333333333333'
else: code='2222222222222222222222222222222222222222'
print(code)

notes: Executor-only read-runtime classifier. Always exits 0 and prints a final 40-hex sentinel: 000 no planner; aaaa planner not complete; 111 planner complete/no builder; 222 builder selected; 333 builder complete; 444 builder failed. No supervisor start or mutation outside isolated worktree.
